reader_question: Which columns survive selection, and in what order?
main_message: One mask selects the first and third columns while preserving their order.

nodes.label: Input matrix
nodes.representation: A three-row, four-column grid. Highlight columns one and three using the retained-column palette role; show columns two and four neutrally.

nodes.label: Column mask
nodes.representation: A compact four-position strip labeled 1, 0, 1, 0, aligned with the four input columns.

nodes.label: Select columns
nodes.representation: In the overview use a compact selector symbol. In the detail show one three-by-four grid beside the corresponding three-by-two grid, with selected columns visibly retaining their left-to-right order. Pair the overview symbol and detail with the same A badge; they depict one operation.

nodes.label: Selected matrix
nodes.representation: A three-row, two-column grid containing the original first and third columns. Keep the retained-column colors unchanged.

edges.meaning: The full matrix enters the selection operation
The mask specifies which columns are retained
The operation outputs the retained columns in their original order

layouts.name: Compact overview above an enlarged explanation

regions.purpose: Locate the single selection operation in the full input-to-output path
regions.placement: across the upper quarter, with the mask above the selector

regions.purpose: Make retained-column order visible at a glance
regions.placement: across the lower three quarters, centered below the overview

zoom_links.meaning: The detail enlarges the selector marked A in the overview

layouts.tradeoff: The broad matrix explanation receives more space than the overall process.
layouts.reason_to_choose: The retained-column ordering is the reader's central question.

layouts.name: Vertical context beside a broad detail

regions.purpose: Locate the single selection operation in the full input-to-output path
regions.placement: in the left third, with the main path descending and the mask beside the selector

regions.purpose: Make retained-column order visible at a glance
regions.placement: in the right two thirds, aligned with the overview selector

zoom_links.meaning: The detail enlarges the selector marked A in the overview

layouts.tradeoff: A taller overview leaves less horizontal space for the enlarged matrices.
layouts.reason_to_choose: Useful when the final figure must fit a wide, shallow space.

palette.meaning: Input columns absent from the output

line_roles.data: solid dark arrows with clear arrowheads
line_roles.zoom: matching blue A badges and paired rounded outlines

style.text_policy: Use the four node labels and short column numbers only; do not put sentences inside the grids.

omit.reason: Column identity and order explain the toy rule without arbitrary values

review_focus.question: Do the retained columns preserve their original order, and is the detail clearly the same operation as the A-marked overview selector?
